snippet.title: ABYSS REBEL // Teaser
snippet.description:
Play the Game ► https://store.steampowered.com/app/3855320/ABYSS_REBEL/

ABYSS REBEL is a Turn-Based Tactical RPG combining grid strategy, intense combat, and loot progression. Set sail for a frozen archipelago at the universe’s edge, lead a four-member squad on a skiff, equipping skills, relics, tackling bosses and summoning mechs to shatter encroaching darkness!

Developed by
DRock Games
